description: Fix shared-Oban rolling deployment race: startup job carries inserting pod version; worker uses it for comparison, falling back for legacy/cron jobs. Preserve force and enabled-badge skip. Action reuse assessment: operation is internal startup release check; inspected Zaq.System.ReleaseUpdate.check_for_update/0, Zaq.System.UpdateBadgeWorker.perform/1, Zaq.System.get_config/set_config and startup Oban insertion. Extend existing domain checker and reuse worker/config persistence; no standalone actor/permission contract or agent/workflow consumer, so local-only (no new Action/tool). Inputs: trusted runtime app version string or absent; output existing status/error, badge persisted only on successful fetch, retries via Oban. Verify explicit version, legacy fallback, skip/force, GitHub errors with isolated tests. No Kubernetes or version-ordering changes.
title: [update-badge-rollout] Compare startup badge against scheduling pod version
